title: Pendleton County Community Data Atlas public map collection
summary: Four ArcGIS web maps supporting community, traffic, infrastructure, resilience, recreation, trail, park, public-facility, and tourism exploration in Pendleton County, West Virginia.
description: Public interactive maps embedded in the EPA RERC Pendleton County Community Data Atlas. The maps combine project-maintained reference layers with source-agency services. They support exploration and do not rank projects, determine site eligibility, or replace source-agency review.
publication_target: GitHub Pages dashboard with public ArcGIS Online web maps
geometry_type: Mixed point, line, and polygon web-map collection
crs: Web map display uses WGS 1984 Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere; project point coordinates originate in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).
source_lineage: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb and 2024 ACS 5-year
West Virginia Department of Transportation AADT services
USDA Forest Service administrative-boundary and trail services
OpenStreetMap mapped civic, park, trail, and tourism inventory with project review
Official locality, operator, and Pendleton County visitor sources
update_cadence: Source-dependent; source release years and limitations remain visible in the dashboard.
steward: Pendleton County EPA RERC dashboard project team; source agencies remain authoritative data stewards.
contact: Use the linked source agency or Pendleton County Convention and Visitors Bureau contact for source-specific questions.
use_constraints: Public reference use. Verify current conditions, ownership, access, flood determinations, traffic count years, facility status, and safety information with the responsible source. Mapped inventories are not guaranteed exhaustive.
public_claim_limits: Community points are orientation references, not service-area boundaries.
District statistics are not place-specific statistics.
Franklin and Brandywine place profiles use separate Census place geographies.
Traffic collection years vary by feature.
Flood layers do not constitute a parcel-level determination.
Civic, park, trail, and tourism inventories may be incomplete or change over time.
